content: Nyubunyinja Queenangka bubumun Shebamun, nyulu kuku nyajin Solomonanka. Nyulu kuku nyajin Solomon binal bajaku, dukul-ngulkurr bajaku. Yinyaynka nyulu Solomonanda kadan, kuku nyungun babanka. Nyulu presents jirray nyungunji wundin, Solomonanda dajinka. Nyulu kuku nyungun baban, yamba Solomonangka kuku wubulku mala-yirrkan.

Solomonangka bayan wubul ngaran, dishes goldmun kananga yijarrin. Nyulu boat wubul yungan jalundurr, jana gold, silver, monkeys wundin nyunguwunbu bubungu. Nyulu jarra rich-balaman jananka kinganka yiringkurrku. Nyulu yalarrku army jirray-bungan, soldier-soldier wubul, yarraman wubul. Nyulu junkurrjiman, bama nyunguwunbu bubungu ngulkurrduku kujin.
